archivo.pregunta: Prof. Delgado: what separates a founder's 'problem' from a 'symptom'?
archivo.respuesta: A problem is what the customer pays to remove; a symptom is what they complain about. Interview for the payment, not the complaint.

archivo.pregunta: The coach's rule for the first line of a hard email in US English?
archivo.respuesta: Lead with the shared goal, then the ask. A verdict in line one reads as aggression even when it is right.
archivo.origen: Coach · a pattern from three mails this week

items.pregunta: What is Prof. Marchetti's 'thesis test' for any RIA paragraph?
items.respuesta: Delete the paragraph. If the argument still stands, the paragraph was decoration.
items.por_que: Your draft has two paragraphs of context before the first claim; the test cuts both.

items.pregunta: What is the first question to ask before automating any step at Grupo Ferra?
items.respuesta: Is this step the constraint? If it is not, speeding it up adds inventory, not throughput (Goldratt).
items.por_que: Her board meets {{W+2}}; the answer to her second question is this one sentence.

items.pregunta: In Prof. Okonkwo's words, what does a p-value under 0.05 tell you, and what does it not?
items.respuesta: That the data would be unusual if nothing were going on. It says nothing about how big the effect is or whether it matters.
items.por_que: You wrote 'significant = important' in the problem-set draft; this corrects the reflex before the quiz.

items.pregunta: What does NEST (Matthew Hale) say its founders need from an AI advisor?
items.respuesta: Someone who can explain AI to founders without the hype: plain words, one working example, no roadmap theater.
items.fuente: Recording · intro call with Prof. Purcell · {{W-4}}
items.por_que: You meet him today at 14:15. The card is his own phrase, so you can give it back to him.

items.pregunta: Prof. Yen's three tests for whether a task belongs to a model or to a person?
items.respuesta: Is a wrong answer recoverable, can a person check it in under a minute, and does it repeat more than ten times a week.
items.por_que: The same three tests Daniela's board will ask in other words. One card covers class and client.
